title: Q1 roadmap prioritization
segments: Sarah
Thanks for joining. The goal today is to lock the Q1 roadmap; we have capacity for roughly three big projects.
Sarah
The candidates are offline mode, the Salesforce integration, a redesign of the reporting dashboard, and SSO for enterprise.
David
Enterprise SSO is blocking two deals worth about 180 thousand dollars in annual revenue, so I'd put it first.
Priya
Agreed on SSO. Engineering estimates it at four weeks with SAML and OIDC support.
Mark
Offline mode is our most requested feature, 340 votes on the feedback board, but it's at least eight weeks of work.
Priya
Offline mode also needs a sync engine rewrite, which is risky. I'd rather start with a two-week spike to de-risk it.
Sarah
Okay, decision: SSO is priority one, and offline mode gets a two-week technical spike in January, full build only if the spike looks good.
David
What about Salesforce? Sales keeps asking for it.
Mark
Only eleven customers asked for Salesforce, and Zapier covers most of the use case today.
Sarah
Then Salesforce moves to Q2. The dashboard redesign takes the third slot since churn interviews keep mentioning reporting.
Priya
For the dashboard we need a designer; Emma is fully booked until mid-January.
Sarah
I'll ask the design lead whether we can borrow a contractor. Mark, please write the dashboard requirements doc by next Friday.
David
Can I tell the two enterprise prospects that SSO ships in Q1?
Sarah
Say end of February, not earlier. Priya, please confirm the SSO timeline with the team by Wednesday.

key_points.point: Capacity for about three big projects in Q1
SSO is priority one: blocks two deals worth ~$180k, ~4 weeks with SAML/OIDC
Offline mode: most requested (340 votes), 8+ weeks; two-week spike in January first
Salesforce integration moved to Q2 (only 11 customers, Zapier covers it)
Dashboard redesign takes third slot because of churn feedback
Need a designer (Emma booked until mid-January); maybe a contractor
Tell prospects SSO ships end of February

action_items.text: Sarah asks design lead about a contractor
Mark writes dashboard requirements doc by next Friday
Priya confirms SSO timeline by Wednesday
